package.name: orma_span
package.description: liborma_span.so: orma_span_begin and orma_span_end, empty functions that mark a stretch inside a callback, the C++ orma::Span and the Python decorator orma_span.span around them. orma catches them by name (LD_PRELOAD and LTTng) or attaches to them (uprobe); without orma a span costs its two calls.
